Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + proposed windows for the technical deep dive

Hi Daniel —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and suggested next steps: 

- Discovery highlights: primary use case is low-latency personalization at checkout, need predictable inference SLAs and clear audit logs.
- Key stakeholders to include: Platform (you), Security (Priya), Procurement (procurement@novumretail.com).
- Asks for deep-dive: SSO/identity flow, data-in-motion and at-rest controls, expected throughput and concurrency.

Proposed windows for a 60–90m technical deep dive with our platform and security leads:
- Wed, Apr 7 — 11:30 AM–1:00 PM PT (preferred)
- Thu, Apr 8 — 2:00 PM–3:30 PM PT

If neither works, let me know a couple windows and I’ll coordinate. I’ve attached the discovery notes we took on today’s call.

I’ll loop in Karthik (technical lead) and Marissa (procurement/solutions) to prepare SSO/network slides and a pricing baseline.

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Cheers,
Lauren Bishop
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0191

Attachment: discovery-notes-20270405.pdf (summary of today's call)

Date: Mon, 05 Apr 2027 11:05:00 -0700

Lauren —

Appreciate the recap. Please include Priya (Security) and procurement on the invite — they need to review architecture and contracting path. A few constraints from our side: no meetings before 11:00 AM PT; our security prefers the deep-dive to include a short run through of how you handle KV caches and data retention.

Available on your suggested times: Wed 4/7 11:30–12:30 PT works for our platform and security. If you can do 90 minutes we can include a short procurement sync at the end.

Also can you confirm whether you support Okta SSO (we use Okta) and share any SOC 2 and key-management docs ahead of the meeting?

Thanks,
Daniel Cho
Platform Lead, Novum Retail

Perfect — Wed 4/7 11:30 PT penciled in.

Karthik / Marissa — looping you both in to own technical + procurement prep:
- Karthik: can you prepare a 10–15 slide pack covering SSO/Okta integration, data flow (KV cache behavior), and list of common security artifacts we can share (SOC 2, encryption at rest, HSM/KMS integration notes). If you can drop a diagram by tomorrow morning that would be great.
- Marissa: can you prepare a simple procurement checklist (standard commercial terms, preferred contract template, and pricing baseline for a 3-month pilot + expected committed throughput).

Daniel / Priya / procurement team — we will send a calendar invite with the Google Meet link and attach the materials ahead of the call.

If anything else you want on the agenda please reply here.

– Lauren
